# Generated by tools/build_events.py. Edit the tables there, not this file.
add_namespace = lr_america

# The governor has fallen. FROM is the colonial government.
country_event = {
	id = lr_america.2
	title = lr_america.2.t
	desc = lr_america.2.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_soldiers_marching
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		annex_country = {
			target = USA
			transfer_troops = yes
		}
		set_cosmetic_tag = LR_CNA_usa
	}

	# Keep the thirteen colonies' victory and make peace with Britain.
	option = {
		name = lr_america.2.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 60 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = LR_tt_cna_peace
		hidden_effect = {
			every_enemy_country = {
				CNA = { white_peace = PREV }
			}
		}
		news_event = { id = lr_america.100 }
	}

	# Go on to Canada.
	option = {
		name = lr_america.2.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 40 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = LR_tt_cna_canada
		set_global_flag = LR_cna_canada
		if = {
			limit = { CAN = { has_capitulated = yes } }
			country_event = { id = lr_america.3 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		annex_country = {
			target = CAN
			transfer_troops = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { 331 = { is_owned_by = ENG } }
			transfer_state = 331
		}

			limit = { 332 = { is_owned_by = ENG } }

		name = lr_america.3.a

			CNA = { white_peace = PREV }
		}

	}
}
